messages:
ops-bot: THROTTLE ALERT — quota-service rollout caused aggressive token consumption in eu regions; visible 429s for free-tier customers and a subset of small paid tenants. status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2450000000 :warning:

sre_lead: timeline quick summary: rollout started at ~09:40 UTC, new rate-bucket algorithm flipped at 09:47, spike in bursts -> immediate enforcement -> widespread throttles by 09:50.

micaela: impact observed: ~12% of requests in eu-west-1 and eu-central returning 429/503 depending on client retry. latency up 150ms median for affected paths.

eng_platform: confirmed the new algorithm mis-calculated sustained vs burst window due to an edge case in our sliding-window logic. reproduced locally with test vector.

sre_lead: mitigation steps applied: 1) roll back quota-service to previous release at 10:12 UTC. 2) applied hotfix rule to relax burst thresholds for free-tier and low-commit customers. 3) temporarily disabled per-route aggressive enforcement for eu regions.

ops-bot: Current status: partial recovery in eu regions; 429 rate down from 18% -> 1.8% in last 15m. Monitoring: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/quota/eu-overview

support_lead: CS action: night shift notified, customer-impact list created, automatic credits queued for accounts that hit >1000 429s during the window. Template for outreach: https://wiki.redwood.ai/docs/incidents/quota-outreach-template

jorge: quick ask to infra teams — any long-running jobs that may have been affected by rollback? we saw a spike in dedicated pod restarts around 10:14.

eng_platform: noted one autoscaler reconciliation for dedicated-pool-3 at 10:15 caused a short overprovision; not customer-facing but correlated. we rolled that back at 10:22.

micaela: customers currently affected should see normalized behavior. if you spot residual 429s, tag me and include request_id and example timestamp.

anna-cs: coordinating with three customers in EU who reported production impact; promise: credits + follow-up call offer.

sre_lead: next steps: full root cause analysis in 72h, postmortem to include test coverage gaps and a safer rollout playbook (canary by region + automatic rollback on 429 surge).

ops-bot: RCA tracker + artifacts: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incident/2450000000/rCA ; postmortem draft due 72h. If you need to escalate to legal/compliance or key customers, ping @sre_lead or @support_lead. :white_check_mark:
